Specifically, add conditions to verify that `iinfo->i_lenEAttr > bs` or `iinfo->i_lenAlloc > bs`, and perform an exact check to ensure that `udf_file_entry_alloc_offset(inode) + iinfo->i_lenAlloc > bs`. These checks will prevent integer overflow and ensure data integrity, thus avoiding potential security issues and maintaining the stability of the UDF filesystem driver.
